product.name: Foldable Magnetic Phone Tripod
product.description: A compact magnetic phone stand that unfolds into a small tripod.

script_facts: The compact phone stand unfolds into a small tripod.
Its magnetic mount requires a compatible phone or magnetic case.
The viewing angle can be adjusted.
An included Bluetooth remote shutter can trigger the paired phone camera.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim universal phone compatibility.
Do not describe the stand as a gimbal or claim electronic stabilization.
Do not claim that the mount charges the phone.
Do not claim a tested load capacity, grip strength, or drop protection.
editorial_direction: Lead with the visual change from a compact folded object into a phone tripod.
Explain the magnetic compatibility limitation plainly.
Use a group photo or hands-free camera setup only as a relatable use case, not as a performance claim.
Mention the remote shutter only with the requirement that it is paired to the phone.
Do not mention a brand, price, rating, or affiliate details.
